'''Shenax''' was a male [[Twi'leki/Legends|Ryl]]-speaking [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] residing on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] he was engaged in [[Slavery/Legends|slave trade]], and made business with the [[Twin Suns (pirates)|Twin Suns]]. However, he agreed to help a Republic spacer sent by [[Sheriff/Legends|Sheriff]] [[Encot]], who was looking for captured [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] residents, by revealing to them that slaves are shipped from hangar 21 in [[Anchorhead Spaceport]].<ref name="Smuggler's Route" />
